question: Should ClawHub change from the existing fixed MIT-0 skill-license policy to a supported MIT-or-MIT-0 model for declared skill metadata, including existing-version backfill behavior?
rationale: The patch is technically coherent, but it reverses a prior maintainer-stated product/legal direction and changes public API, storage, docs, and attribution expectations.

options.title: Approve mixed MIT/MIT-0 with backfill plan
options.body: Confirm the new license contract, require real behavior proof, and document how existing MIT-declared versions will be backfilled safely before merge.

options.title: Narrow to future publishes only
options.body: Accept MIT detection only for new versions and leave existing-version repair to a separate migration or policy issue.

options.title: Reaffirm fixed MIT-0
options.body: Pause or close this PR and keep the current platform-wide MIT-0 publishing contract.

recommendation.title: Approve mixed MIT/MIT-0 with backfill plan
recommendation.body: Confirm the new license contract, require real behavior proof, and document how existing MIT-declared versions will be backfilled safely before merge.
